Title: F1 Authentication and user accounts
Description: Sign-in for Owner Docket users; map internal team contacts (OD Acquisition Holdings, tagged Internal) to user accounts; replace the prototype 'Acting as' switcher.

Title: F2 Roles and permissions
Description: Role model (e.g., Admin, Deal lead, Deal team, Viewer). Enforce approver-only actions server-side; restrict personal contact data by role; decide who can complete/skip/bypass checklist work.

Title: F3 Database schema
Description: Implement the schema for buildings, identifiers, tracked fields, ownerships, organizations, contacts, deals, deal-buildings, deal contacts, reports, checklist items/stages/sub-items/documents/history, documents, site visits, communications, activities.

Title: F4 API layer
Description: Endpoints for CRUD and the domain actions currently in src/store/DataProvider.tsx (e.g., approve, request changes, bypass, change owner, set deal approver, undo auto-advance).

Title: F5 Replace prototype store with API data
Description: Swap DataProvider/localStorage for API calls (e.g., TanStack Query) while keeping screens unchanged; remove versioned localStorage migrations.

Title: F6 File storage
Description: Object storage for building documents, checklist documentation, photos, logos and contact photos (replace session-only bytes and inline data URLs); virus scan; signed URLs.

Title: F7 Audit log / activity service
Description: Server-side activity entries for every mutation (who, what, when), reusing the activity types in the prototype; checklist item history.

Title: F8 Business rules on the server
Description: Port src/lib/checklist.ts (progress, auto stages, phases, auto-advance, approver rule) and selectors (docStats, attention items, dealView, companyDeals) to the backend or a shared package; keep the unit tests as the contract.

Title: F9 Global search
Description: Server-backed search across buildings (incl. identifiers), deals, contacts and documents.
